findings.summary: An approved, committed DotPixel contract already exists in contracts/ (dot-pixel-contract workflow, commit f4174c6) with an incompatible interface: bytes32[4] vs uint256[], MSB-first vs LSB-first nibbles, setBlacklisted(bool)/BlacklistUpdated vs add/remove + Blacklisted/Unblacklisted, getAllDrawings with ownerBlacklisted flag vs contract-level getGallery, DrawingView[] tuples vs parallel arrays, oldest-first vs newest-first, title 1..32 required vs 0..31 optional, clearable username, no EmptyDrawing, pendingOwner blacklistable, different function/error names, flattened Remix file. Spec also contradicts itself (§12.19 cites existing foundry.lock, task 1.1 creates contracts/ from scratch). Ask the user to choose: (A) adapt spec to the existing contract, or (B) spec supersedes it and task 1 rewrites it in place with confirmation, keeping git/submodules.
NewOwnerBlacklisted check in acceptOwnership is unreachable (pending owner can never be blacklisted); document as defense-only or drop to save bytes.
Unblacklisting re-pushes old drawings to the end of _galleryIds so they appear newest; extend S6 to say so.
